description: This file contains the implementation of the TaxRate class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation namespace. It provides methods for managing tax rate entities, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving tax rate data, as well as handling relationships with customer groups and geo zones.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Represents the TaxRate model for managing tax rate data, including CRUD operations and relationships with customer groups and geo zones.

methods.name: addTaxRate
methods.description: Inserts a new tax rate record into the database and associates customer groups if provided.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Updates an existing tax rate record and resets associated customer group relationships.

methods.name: deleteTaxRate
methods.description: Deletes a tax rate record and its associated customer group relationships.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific tax rate by ID.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRates
methods.description: Returns the total count of tax rate records.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRatesByGeoZoneId
methods.description: Returns the total number of tax rates associated with a specific geo zone.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a tax rate with a customer group.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Deletes all customer group associations for a given tax rate.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroupsByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Deletes all associations of a specified customer group with tax rates.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves the list of customer groups associated with a specific tax rate.
